title: 彭博科技主播：苹果指控OpenAI挖角400名员工，硬件合作变诉讼
speaker: Ed Ludlow

segments.en: Yeah, I mean in the suit, Apple describes open AI's hardware effort as nascent but you gave the key details which is that Apple claims are about 400 Apple alumni now working at open AI
segments.zh: 在诉讼中，苹果称OpenAI的硬件努力尚在初期，但关键细节是苹果声称约有400名前苹果员工现在在OpenAI工作。

segments.en: and the specifics which open AI executives coached those hires as the suit alleges on how to sort of leave Apple smoothly with as the suit alleges documents etc.
segments.zh: 诉讼还指控OpenAI高管指导这些员工如何顺利离职，并带走文件等。

segments.en: We don't know much about the form factor where open AI's at with its device progress but the back story is very much bigger than that, a couple of years ago the company started working together on software for the iPhone, integrating open AI's AI technology in Siri,
segments.zh: 我们不清楚OpenAI设备进展的具体形态，但背景故事远不止于此。几年前两家公司开始合作，为iPhone开发软件，将OpenAI的AI技术整合到Siri中。

segments.en: then Johnny Ive struck up a relationship with Apple and with open AI sorry and it's kind of soured from there, the net result we don't know.
segments.zh: 随后乔纳森·艾维与苹果和OpenAI都建立了关系，但关系从此承压，最终结果未知。
